comparison.objective: Place and hold a nail upright while another arm hammers it, then withdraw safely; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Shared-workspace fixturing, timing release, and collision avoidance during impacts versus bimanual two-tool countertorque on threaded hardware.
comparison.success_condition: Score is continuous nail penetration over 4 cm, with arm/hammer contact forcing zero; no separate numeric release dwell or partial tiers are specified.
comparison.reason: Holding a workpiece for a collaborating hammering arm does not test preservation of an adjustable screw setting during jam-nut locking.
